status: PROVISIONAL. Not approved by owner; separate from approved v1.1 source ratings.
method: Individually proposed editorial judgements on v1.1 5-attribute scale (not formula derived); no match results considered.

sol-campbell.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Elite strength and recovery positioning; composed covering centre-back.

gary-neville.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Disciplined full-back, persistent overlapping and positional reading.

patrice-evra.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Agile overlapping full-back with sustained recovery and work rate.

jamie-carragher.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Tough, vocal cover defender with great tactical positioning.

kolo-toure.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Mobile, physical ball winner; positional reading good but not exceptional.

branislav-ivanovic.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Aerial strength and commitment; dependable marking but limited turning agility.

kyle-walker.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Exceptional pace in recovery, durable defensive athlete.

trent-alexander-arnold.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. World-class passing full-back; attacking positioning more reliable than defensive marking.

andrew-robertson.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Relentless overlapping and tracking; very high endurance.

ruben-dias.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Elite organizer and anticipation; measured use of strength.

david-silva.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Superior close-space calm and final-pass invention; selective pressing.

michael-carrick.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Calm deep distributor and screened lanes; not quick laterally.

fernandinho.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Intense defensive midfielder with elite covering and disciplined pressing.

ilkay-gundogan.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Intelligent late penalty-area runs and retention under pressure.

santi-cazorla.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Two-footed close control and passing; small but press-resistant.

bruno-fernandes.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Relentless chance creator and runner with high-risk decisions.

christian-eriksen.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Precise distribution and vision; tidy but not exceptional in duels.

paul-pogba.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Elite physical technical midfielder; inconsistent off-ball coverage.

mousa-dembele.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Incredible pressure resistance through balance and ball protection.

declan-rice.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Consistent midfield cover and interceptions; progressive carries.

sergio-aguero.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Sharp changes of direction, elite finishing decisions and box movement.

harry-kane.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Elite finishing composure and creative passing from deep.

robin-van-persie.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Technical left-footed finisher with superb first-touch shot creation.

erling-haaland.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Explosive physical box specialist with lethal timing.

fernando-torres.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Peak Liverpool acceleration and direct box threat.

gareth-bale.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Long-striding pace, powerful strikes and athletic carrying.

son-heung-min.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Two-footed composure and intelligent off-shoulder runs.

sadio-mane.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Relentless pressing winger with explosive diagonal runs.

ruud-van-nistelrooy.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Clinical box positioning and exceptional one-touch finishing.

riyad-mahrez.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Deceptive dribbling and control in tight right-wing pockets.

jamie-vardy.rationale: Provisional editorial individual assessment. Constant pressing and direct runs behind a high defensive line.
